mechanics.original_reminder: When this dies, exile it, then create a 1/1 token copy without resilience.
mechanics.executable_reminder: Keyword ability "resilience" — When this permanent dies, exile it, then create a token that's a copy of it, except it's 1/1 and it doesn't have custom keyword "resilience".

rule_text.name: 702.280a
rule_text.rule: Resilience is a triggered ability. “Resilience” means “When this permanent is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, exile it, then create a token that's a copy of it, except the token is 1/1 and doesn't have resilience.”

rule_text.name: 702.280b
rule_text.rule: If a permanent has multiple instances of resilience, multiple 1/1 token copies of it will be created, but those tokens will lose all instances of resilience.
